about.disclaimer.p1: This site aggregates public information only and is not investment, procurement, or technology-selection advice. Leaderboards and pricing may lag or use different definitions; keep the original source and timestamp when citing.
about.disclaimer.p2: All trademarks and content belong to their respective owners. If you are a rights holder and want something removed, contact us through a GitHub Issue and we'll handle it as soon as possible.
about.disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
about.facts.title: Collection scope
about.follow.citeDesc: When citing data from this site, keep the original source link and update time; share cards include the site address so forwards stay traceable.
about.follow.desc: Bookmark the site, subscribe to a feed, or follow the project on GitHub. Every update is public — no account needed.
about.follow.shareDesc: Every share card carries the site address and a QR code slot, so forwards on chat or social platforms lead back to the source.
about.follow.title: Find us
about.lede: AI Pulse is an open, fully static LLM tracker: no sign-in, no tracking, no backend. It only aggregates public data, labels every source and update time, and presents change through restrained design.
about.method.collect.desc: Pull first-hand information from public APIs, datasets, and RSS: model catalogs, pricing, leaderboards, vendor updates, and community projects. Failures are retried automatically and raw snapshots are kept.
about.method.collect.title: Collect
about.method.desc: Collect → normalize → validate → publish, fully scripted and reproducible.
about.method.label: Method
about.method.normalize.desc: Unify fields, units, and time zones: pricing in USD / 1M tokens, timestamps in ISO 8601, HTML stripped from text, and stable slugs for IDs.
about.method.normalize.title: Normalize
about.method.publish.desc: Generate JSON plus RSS / Atom / JSON Feed, refreshed daily by GitHub Actions and deployed as a static site. The frontend is read-only and never re-invents content.
about.method.publish.title: Released
about.method.title: How the data is made
about.method.transparency.desc: Every data block shows an update time and source. When a source is unreachable or a field is missing, the site shows a degraded or empty state instead of guessing or filling gaps.
about.method.transparency.point1: Show public, citable data only, with original links preserved.
about.method.transparency.point2: No crawling behind logins, no full-text storage; removal requests are honored.
about.method.transparency.point3: No user profiling and no tracking scripts.
about.method.transparency.title: Transparency and restraint
about.method.validate.desc: Check required fields, enum values, and referential consistency against the data contract. When counts look abnormal, publishing is blocked so bad data can't overwrite good data.
about.method.validate.title: Validate
about.notice: This is a personally maintained, non-commercial project. Data may lag or use different definitions; always defer to the original source.
about.sources.caption: Data source status list
about.sources.desc: Status reflects the latest collection run: OK / Degraded / Unavailable. When a source is degraded, the related module shows an explanatory empty state.
about.sources.error: Data source information is temporarily unavailable
about.sources.label: Data sources
about.sources.title: Public data source status
about.stack.note: No frameworks, no build step, no external fonts or images, no third-party tracking.
about.stack.title: Tech stack
about.update.label: Updates & subscriptions
about.update.p1: GitHub Actions runs the data pipeline on a daily schedule (manual runs are supported too). After data changes, JSON and feeds are regenerated and deployed — a static site needs no database.
about.update.p2: Subscribe via RSS / Atom or JSON Feed and use any reader you like; you can also follow the project on GitHub.
about.update.title: Refreshed automatically every day
